purpose: Freeze one canonical R09 D0 acceptance matrix from the already-merged R00-R08 authorities before any new terminal artifact execution.

canonicalAcceptanceMatrix.requirement: Generated questions pass the admitted semantic and answer validators for their selected capability.

canonicalAcceptanceMatrix.requirement: Real public HTML preserves title, metadata, question content and worksheet structure from the canonical WorksheetDocument.

canonicalAcceptanceMatrix.requirement: Real browser PDF/print output preserves worksheet structure without overflow, clipping, question overlap, missing answers or abnormal blank pages.
Terminal artifacts retain persistent lineage back to selected public capability state and generated worksheet identity.
Same-seed generation remains deterministic while regenerate semantics remain valid for the selected mode.
canonicalAcceptanceMatrix.evidenceSource: R08 A05 exact replay and R08 A00 acceptance contract

canonicalAcceptanceMatrix.requirement: The exact R09 candidate head passes the full repository regression with no pre-existing-error exemption.
R09 terminal acceptance preserves real HTML/PDF/browser evidence as immutable CI artifacts or committed readback references.
canonicalAcceptanceMatrix.evidenceSource: R07/R08 evidence pattern and R09 D0 objective

canonicalAcceptanceMatrix.requirement: R09 re-determines the Public Generation product state from terminal evidence rather than inheriting an R08 label.
Slice014 remains frozen until every R09 D0 gate is terminal PASS and the R09 closeout is merged to main.

goalDistance.distanceReduced: Converted the merged R00-R08 authority chain into one bounded R09 terminal acceptance contract without rerunning or weakening prior evidence.
